(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define mid-r (- (rows g) 1))
    (define mid-c (- (cols g) 1))
    (define (top? obj) (< (* 2 (apply + (obj-rs obj))) (* (obj-size obj) mid-r)))
    (define (left? obj) (< (* 2 (apply + (obj-cs obj))) (* (obj-size obj) mid-c)))
    (define (shape obj) (subgrid g (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj) (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c2 obj)))
    (define objs (objects g 0))
    (define tl (map shape (filter (lambda (obj) (and (top? obj) (left? obj))) objs)))
    (define tr (map shape (filter (lambda (obj) (and (top? obj) (not (left? obj)))) objs)))
    (define bl (map shape (filter (lambda (obj) (and (not (top? obj)) (left? obj))) objs)))
    (define br (map shape (filter (lambda (obj) (and (not (top? obj)) (not (left? obj)))) objs)))
    (define s-tl (if (empty? tl) #f (first tl)))
    (define s-tr (if (empty? tr) #f (first tr)))
    (define s-bl (if (empty? bl) #f (first bl)))
    (define s-br (if (empty? br) #f (first br)))
    (define top-h (max (if s-tl (rows s-tl) 1) (if s-tr (rows s-tr) 1)))
    (define bot-h (max (if s-bl (rows s-bl) 1) (if s-br (rows s-br) 1)))
    (define left-w (max (if s-tl (cols s-tl) 1) (if s-bl (cols s-bl) 1)))
    (define right-w (max (if s-tr (cols s-tr) 1) (if s-br (cols s-br) 1)))
    (define (paste-shape out shape top left)
      (if (not shape)
          out
          (for*/fold ([acc out])
                     ([r (in-range (rows shape))]
                      [c (in-range (cols shape))])
            (let ((v (at shape r c)))
              (if (not (= v 0)) (set-cell acc (+ top r) (+ left c) v) acc)))))
    (paste-shape
      (paste-shape
        (paste-shape
          (paste-shape (empty-grid (+ top-h 1 bot-h) (+ left-w 1 right-w) 0) s-tl 0 0)
          s-tr 0 (+ left-w 1))
        s-bl (+ top-h 1) 0)
      s-br (+ top-h 1) (+ left-w 1))))
